title: Form
description: Fiori form (ui5-form): responsive label/field layout with columns per size range, labelSpan / emptySpan, groups, display (definition list) and edit modes.

usage.summary: Arrange related labels and fields for one record in responsive groups.
useWhen: Let users inspect or edit related fields of one record in a consistent layout.
Group fields by meaning and keep their labels aligned as available width changes.
Use accessibleMode="edit" for editable fields; the default display mode presents label-value pairs.

avoidWhen.when: Compare repeated records in rows rather than fields of one record.
Guide users through 3–8 task steps instead of editing fields together.
Submit or validate data automatically; provide caller-owned submission and validation.
